question: What was the total expense ratio (TER) of the Class S GBP Distributing share class of the GFI Fund sub-fund of Guggenheim Global Investments plc for the financial year ended 31 December 2025?

question: How did redemptions of redeemable participating shares of the GGI Fund sub-fund of Guggenheim Global Investments plc in the financial year 2025 compare with 2024?
reference_answer: GGI Fund redemptions were USD (1,660) thousand in 2025 versus USD (18,496) thousand in 2024, i.e. redemptions fell sharply (by about USD 16,836 thousand). The figures of the larger GFI Fund (USD (149,697) thousand in 2025 and USD (185,982) thousand in 2024) are a different sub-fund.

question: By what percentage did the net assets attributable to holders of redeemable participating shares of the GFI Fund sub-fund of Guggenheim Global Investments plc change between 31 December 2024 and 31 December 2025?
reference_answer: GFI Fund net assets rose from USD 703,905 thousand at 31 December 2024 to USD 752,433 thousand at 31 December 2025, an increase of USD 48,528 thousand, i.e. +6.9% (6.89% before rounding to one decimal).
